sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Arshavir Sarkisovich Abramyan, known by his alias "Ragman", is a trader in Escape from Tarkov and Escape from Tarkov: Arena.

sections.heading: Biography
sections.text: Previously, he worked as a director in a shopping center located in the suburbs of Tarkov. Now dealing in mostly clothing- and gear-related items, anywhere from sunglasses to body armor.
